newsitem.title: UK: Alliance & Leicester members to agree float.
newsitem.headline: Alliance & Leicester members to agree float.

text.p: Members of the Alliance & Leicester building society, voting by proxy on its proposal to convert to Plc status and float on the London Stock Exchange, have voted overwhelmingly in favour, it said on Tuesday.
The float is expected to go ahead in the second quarter of next year and every eligible member will receive an allocation of 250 shares.
Members attending a special general meeting of the society were casting their votes on Tuesday and the Alliance said it will announce the full result later.
The flotation proposal has attracted criticism from depositors with large accounts, who are angry that they will get the same allocation of shares as those with much smaller accounts.

The Alliance's timetable has also been thrown into some confusion by the fact that the British government has still not published a revised draft of its Building Societies bill, which may affect the society's status after it has gone public.
